import sys
import re

def solve():
    line = sys.stdin.readline()
    if not line:
        return
    # Find first token (integer) and the rest of the line
    match = re.search(r'\S+', line)
    if match:
        n = int(match.group())
        str_rest = line[match.end():]  # rest of line after the integer, including any whitespace
    else:
        n = 0
        str_rest = ""

    if n <= 0:
        print("0 0")
        return

    s = str_rest[:n]  # substring of first n characters

    # Split into tokens: sequences of non-delimiters or single delimiters
    tokens = re.findall(r'[^_()]+|[_()]', s)

    inside = False
    cur_len = 0
    inside_words = 0
    max_len = 0

    for token in tokens:
        if token == "_" or token == "(" or token == ")":
            if cur_len > 0:
                if inside:
                    inside_words += 1
                elif cur_len > max_len:
                    max_len = cur_len
                cur_len = 0
            if token == "(":
                inside = True
            elif token == ")":
                inside = False
        else:
            cur_len += len(token)

    if cur_len > 0:
        if inside:
            inside_words += 1
        elif cur_len > max_len:
            max_len = cur_len

    print(f"{max_len} {inside_words}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
